cards.answer: Corki is a marksman/mage who combines basic attacks with explosive missiles and a resistance-shredding frontal gun. His damage includes physical, magic and bonus true damage, with an AD build focus.
cards.counterplay: Dodge his missiles, leave his frontal cone and avoid chasing through his fire trail.

cards.answer: Phosphorus Bomb explodes at a target location, dealing magic damage in an area. It grants sight around the impact and reveals enemy champions hit.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the targeted area; be cautious about hiding after being hit.

cards.answer: Valkyrie dashes to a target location, leaving a fire trail that continually deals magic damage to enemies within.
cards.counterplay: Leave the fire trail and account for his dash when pursuing him.

cards.answer: Gatling Gun continually deals physical damage in a cone toward Corki's facing direction. Repeated hits stack armor and magic resistance reductions, refreshing their duration.
cards.counterplay: Move out of his frontal cone and avoid lingering in the spray.

cards.answer: Missile Barrage stores missiles over time; each missile explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing physical area damage. Every third missile is a Big One with increased damage, range and explosion size. Basic attacks against champions speed up missile recharge.
cards.counterplay: Dodge missiles, keep space from their impact area and be especially cautious when a Big One is ready.
